five_second.sells: online creative/mindfulness art courses (manifesting, neurographica, pattern drawing)
five_second.for_whom: people wanting a calming, self-improvement creative practice
five_second.price_guess: no price visible on landing; guessed somewhere $100-$300

features_used.moment: Used the hamburger menu to find the Courses page and located the Zendala course among six course tiles.
Scrolled through the full course page reading about techniques (Betweed, Meer, Aquafleur patterns), which convinced me the teacher genuinely knows Zentangle/Zendala.

features_used.feature: currency toggle (Pay in US dollars / Pay in British pounds)
features_used.moment: Found dual pay buttons right on the course page and picked the pounds one instead of guessing at a dollar-to-pound conversion.
Followed the footer link to Terms & Conditions and found a specific UK 14-day cooling-off clause for digital purchases.
Clicked through to checkout and saw the price stated unambiguously as £75.00 GBP at the very top of the card form.
Noticed the checkout defaulted Country to United States and labelled the field 'ZIP code' rather than postcode, even though I was paying in pounds.

features_looked_for_but_missing: an upfront note that the course is instant digital delivery, not a physical shipment
student reviews/testimonials specific to the Zendala course itself
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the 'Pay in British pounds' option showing a clear £75 GBP price both on the course page and unambiguously at checkout
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the course being credited to a different-sounding teacher name ('Ann Diane Tai' / 'Tangle with Ann') than the site's own branding (Anna Denning), which briefly made me doubt I was in the right place before the page explained it was a partner teacher within Neuro Art School

friction.moment: Course page credited to 'Ann Diane Tai' / 'Tangle with Ann', a different name to the site's Anna Denning branding, with no immediate explanation up top - a moment of doubt about whether I'd wandered onto the wrong seller's page.
Homepage gave no course names or prices at all; had to dig through the hamburger menu and Courses list before reaching anything relevant to my errand.
Checkout form defaulted Country to United States and used 'ZIP code' instead of postcode, despite correctly charging in GBP.

delight.moment: Seeing 'Pay in British pounds' sitting right next to 'Pay in US dollars' on the course page itself, before I even had to ask.
Checkout header showing '£75.00 GBP' in bold, completely unambiguous - exactly what I needed to trust the price before entering card details.

what_earned_it: clear GBP price shown both pre-checkout and at checkout
UK-registered company (Neuro Art School Ltd) named in Terms & Conditions
specific UK 14-day cooling-off refund clause for digital purchases
genuinely detailed, craft-specific course content naming real Zentangle patterns
trust.what_it_would_take: a 5 would need the refund policy to be reachable in one tap from the checkout itself rather than three clicks deep in Terms & Conditions, and the teacher-name mismatch on the course page explained higher on the page instead of after several scrolls.

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's Anna Denning's Neuro Art School - I found a proper Zendala circular pattern drawing course taught by a Certified Zentangle teacher, and it let me pay in actual pounds so I knew exactly what I'd be charged.
